Descriptor 2f920 points to 10-entry 8-byte callback table 2fb48; index6 is 2464a (sets timer or completion flag), index7 is 244f8 (tests 23282, otherwise marks completion after calling 20dae), index8 is 24524 (calls 2317a then delay), and index9 is 2454e (d19e). 2317a updates state+154 bit200 and calls 2309e and 230f0. Under Silent, selector1b146=0 suppresses this type4 dispatch, but 1a7ac still invokes 1b54a(0), which schedules descriptor0; 1a812 invokes 1b494(selector, other argument), and that function invokes 22f4e. Descriptor0 table2f958 maps sparse step keys (not positional indices): key3->23af4, key4->23bb0, key5->23bf6, key6->23c52, key7->23c82. 20c2a matches the current key; 20b20 advances it. At key3, 23af4 calls22ebe(state+154 bit80), then24730; for Silent this gate is false and its type4 28244 branch is skipped. Key4 callback23bb0 still invokes248be(1); for type4, 248be writes output+238=0 and+38=0. Key5 callback23bf6 invokes248be(22ebe()) (therefore skipped with bit80 clear) but type4 also calls28304 and236a4. Key6 callback23c52 calls24730(1), which is independent of Silent, and may update software state. Key7 callback23c82 starts from22ebe()->24730, so its main branch is gated off when bit80 is clear. This is a partial control-flow trace, not proof of physical stillness or movement. Evidence: a6300-darwin-primary-sequence.json, a6300-darwin-primary-sequence-seeded.json, a6300-darwin-primary-sequence-helpers.json, a6300-darwin-primary-output-helpers.json and independent LLVM 23af4..23b26.

verified_a6000.limit: Absence of that assignment and extra argument is verified for these routines only; this does not prove physical sensor incapability. ROM literals DAT1661c, DAT19bbc and DAT205a0 all equal RAM200036d8; DAT55a0=MMIO42668000, so 51c0(0x238,v) writes port address42668238 (P4E), whose board net is still unknown.
verified_a6000.descriptor_comparison: Raw ROM 28-byte descriptor structures cross-checked at base4200. A6000 29d90/29dac each have 17 callback records (tables29e00/29e70, RAM2000381c/1d/18); A6300 2f8cc/2f8e8 each have 30 records (tables2f958/2fa28, RAM20003628/29/24). A6000 29dc8 has 7 records (table29ee0, RAM2000381e/1f/20); A6300 2f920 has 10 (table2fb48, RAM2000362a/2b/2c). Both have six-record tables at A6000 29de4 and A6300 2f93c. A6300 also has 30-record descriptor2f904 in this cluster; no one-to-one extra descriptor is established in A6000. These are structurally corresponding candidate sequences, not proof of identical physical nets. The A6000 first 17-record table maps keys1/2/3 to callbacks20724/20734/207be; the A6300 first 30-record table maps keys1/3/4 to23ae4/23af4/23bb0. The tables contain repeated and nonmonotonic keys, so record position must not be treated as sequence step.
verified_a6000.primary_callback_trace: The first A6000 17-record sequence has key1 20724 (timed completion), key2 20734 (state reset and gated setup), key3 207be (20cd4 writes output+238=0 when physical type20c74 is 1..3), key4 207e8 (same output reset and optional 16ff4 no-op), key5 2081c (software state transition), key6 2083c (conditional state/timing), key7 209a2 (wait for 1ffbe). The alternate A6000 seven-record sequence has key4 20aa4, which calls20d00; 20d00 writes output+238=1 with the same type gate. The direct GPIO writer51c0 stores into an MMIO base+offset, but no circuit/curtain assignment is proven. 2089c selects subpaths by state+153 values0..3 through TBB at208e0: type0 returns, type1 stores interval at+156 then calls21014(mode0), type2 stores+15a then calls20fde, type3 stores+158 then calls21014(mode1). LLVM verified TBB bytes and direct branches; Ghidra did not recover this jump table. These paths show the A6000 software already sequences a physical output but do not demonstrate an electronic rear curtain. Evidence a6000-darwin-primary-sequence-seeded.json, a6000-darwin-sequence-remaining-callbacks.json, a6000-darwin-primary-output-followup.json, a6000-darwin-output-gates.json, a6000-darwin-step8-type-dispatch.json and LLVM disassembly.
verified_a6000.secondary_dispatch_origin: A6000 2041e(param) selects descriptor0 when param=0 and descriptor2 (29dc8, seven callbacks) when nonzero. For param=0 it calls20d00, setting output+238=1 under physical type gate; for nonzero it sets state+152=9 and dispatches20c06(2). Wrappers19932 and19948 call2041e after19b9e; 19932 forces0, whereas19948 preserves its input. 19b9e requires state+170 bit0 clear and165c8(0x10) nonzero; 165c8 returns 1 only when state+444 bit0x10 is clear. Neither reads a Silent selector. Exposure control18d6e invokes19932 or19948 according to exposure-compensation/timing branches; LLVM at18ec8 confirms the computed R0 is passed to19948. Routine18fa0 also calls19932. No Silent state test was found in these examined A6000 dispatches; this is narrower than proving every possible path lacks one. REA xrefs to descriptor29dc8 and to2041e, Ghidra exports a6000-darwin-secondary-dispatch-callers.json, a6000-darwin-secondary-dispatch-entry.json, a6000-darwin-secondary-command-origin.json, a6000-darwin-secondary-dispatch-gate.json, a6000-darwin-secondary-interlock.json, LLVM 18ec8/19932..1995a.

verified_efcs_packet_bridge.source: Existing efcs-algorithm-arguments.json and a6300-exposure-class-writers.json, independently checked LLVM windows43841342..43841398 and4391aa66..4391aabe
verified_efcs_packet_bridge.a6000: With bank+4bc bit20 clear, exposure class1 produces packet[1] low2bits0; class3 produces low2bits2. Flag43f9b503 changes bit40 only. Additional +14 and OR80 preserve those low2bits.
verified_efcs_packet_bridge.a6300: With bank+50c bit20 clear, class1 produces low2bits0; class3 or class0 produces low2bits2. Flag4415af79 changes bit40 only. Additional +14 and OR80 preserve those low2bits.
verified_efcs_packet_bridge.darwin: Both capture parsers copy packet[1] to state+31. Output policy uses (state[31]&3)==0 separately from the A6300 Silent enable bit at state+d0. This connects EFCS-related class selection to a distinct mechanical policy field; it does not identify individual GPIO nets as curtains.
verified_efcs_packet_bridge.limit: Diagnostic modes, bank bit20 and later Darwin variant overrides must be evaluated separately; class0 in A6000 falls through to lowbits0 and is not equivalent to the A6300 class0 branch.

inference: A6300 Darwin record length, field offset, bit mask, category/operation and request direction match the LIRO CAIF Silent payload and outgoing-body state machine. Static evidence strongly supports a paired protocol and Silent-to-mechanical-control bridge; physical bus connectivity and actual camera behavior are not verified.
